composition_subtypes.role: Sort stones to create sorted cost array for type 2 queries
Build prefix sum arrays for O(1) range sum queries

payload.core_composition_summary: Uses sorting to reorder stones for type 2 queries, and prefix sums (DP) for fast range sums.
payload.rationale: Sorting is essential for the 'cheapest stone' queries; DP prefix sums enable O(1) range answers per query.
